newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - SFE wheat edges down, looks for Chicago lead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - SFE wheat edges down, looks for Chicago lead.

text.p: Australian wheat futures slid further on Monday in continued quiet trading under the spell of Chicago's rangebound performance.
January 1997 was again the only contract to attract interest, falling by A$1.50 to A$190.00 a tonne on 14 trades.
Positions had been set up in last week's market, said Matt Kirk of McIntosh Futures Ltd. "We really need some lead from Chicago to bump it around," he said.
The Australian Wheat Board's pool price revision, to be released tonight, would have quietened the market down as well, he said. There were no option trades on Monday.
